evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 was 4.1 ppm at the start of growth, consistent with the preceding ramp baseline.
O2 increased to 13.1 ppm during growth.
O2 reached 26.5 ppm despite essentially unchanged temperature and argon flow, indicating an atmosphere anomaly.
Temperature 750.1 °C and argon flow 99.4 sccm closely track setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm.
The tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure is unavailable, preventing the required growth-atmosphere verification and limiting fault attribution.

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure measurement, independent O2 verification, and seal-integrity/exhaust-patency checks are needed to distinguish causes of rising oxygen; sample characterization is not yet available.
